verifiedInvariants: The canonical domain booking flow creates calendar_events and service_bookings transactionally.
booking.create checks overlap before insert and returns booking_conflict on collision.
booking.cancel scopes the booking to the current owner/organization and cancels both service_bookings and calendar_events in one transaction.
Booking and calendar writes require backend calendar.manageOwn or calendar.manageOrganization capability; availability/calendar reads require backend authorization.
Legacy api/booking_save.php is disabled with HTTP 410 and points callers to the unified flow.
Booking is not equivalent to RepairOrder.
